jobDescription.text: As a Senior Staff Product Manager in the ITSM Product team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of enterprise service management. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional thinking, identify disruptive opportunities and redefine how enterprises manage IT services and operations.
